not_computable.accepts, rejects, false accepts and fals: summary.json carries the four counts only as run totals; by class it carries claims, automated decisions, wrong automated decisions (false accepts and false rejects together), human reviews, confirmed records, units and days to confirmation. The split by class and error direction exists only in the event journal, which is not downloaded.
not_computable.organisational verification hours and co: no cumulative daily column exists for them; they are reported for the whole run (the shared history is identical in every arm).

administrative_hours_change_per_post_mem.definition: (review + appeal + governance + organisational verification hours of the arm minus those of control-hierarchy) / post member-years of the arm
administrative_hours_change_per_post_mem.label: Governance and administrative time, change vs Hierarchy

administrative_hours_per_member_year_who.definition: review + appeal + governance + organisational verification hours of the whole run over whole-run member-years (r11_outcomes: governance_member_hours_per_member_year)
administrative_hours_per_member_year_who.label: Governance and administrative time

class_disputed_wrong_automated_decisions.label: Disputed records: wrong automated decisions (false accepts + false rejects)

class_inferential_wrong_automated_decisi.label: Inferential records: wrong automated decisions (false accepts + false rejects)

class_objective_wrong_automated_decision.label: Objective records: wrong automated decisions (false accepts + false rejects)

confirmation_mean_days_whole.definition: mean days from submission to confirmation over all confirmed records of the run (summary.json confirmation_mean_days)
confirmation_mean_days_whole.label: Confirmation delay

core_protection_blocks.definition: summary core_blocks (absent = no attempt was journalled)
core_protection_blocks.label: Core-protection blocks

decision_regret_per_available_member_hou.definition: increase of decision_regret_units_cumulative over increase of available_member_work_hours_cumulative from the branch day on
decision_regret_per_available_member_hou.label: Decision regret
decision_regret_per_available_member_hou.unit: regret units per million available member-hours

exits_per_member_year_post.definition: increase of (ever_people - active_members) from the branch day on over post member-years (equals summary exits over the whole run)
exits_per_member_year_post.label: Exits

gini_authority_post_mean.definition: mean of the daily gini_authority over the days from the branch day on
gini_authority_post_mean.label: Formal-authority concentration

hours_appeal_change_per_post_member_year.definition: (whole-run appeal hours of the arm minus those of control-hierarchy) / post member-years of the arm
hours_appeal_change_per_post_member_year.label: Appeal time, change vs Hierarchy

hours_appeal_post_per_member_year.definition: increase of the cumulative appeal hours from the branch day on over post member-years
hours_appeal_post_per_member_year.label: Appeal time, from adoption

hours_appeal_whole_per_member_year.definition: whole-run appeal hours over whole-run member-years
hours_appeal_whole_per_member_year.label: Appeal time, whole run

hours_coordination_change_per_post_membe.definition: (whole-run coordination hours of the arm minus those of control-hierarchy) / post member-years of the arm
hours_coordination_change_per_post_membe.label: Coordination time, change vs Hierarchy

hours_coordination_whole_per_member_year.definition: whole-run coordination hours over whole-run member-years
hours_coordination_whole_per_member_year.label: Coordination time, whole run

hours_governance_change_per_post_member_.definition: (whole-run governance hours of the arm minus those of control-hierarchy) / post member-years of the arm
hours_governance_change_per_post_member_.label: Governance time, change vs Hierarchy

hours_governance_post_per_member_year.definition: increase of the cumulative governance hours from the branch day on over post member-years
hours_governance_post_per_member_year.label: Governance time, from adoption

hours_governance_whole_per_member_year.definition: whole-run governance hours over whole-run member-years
hours_governance_whole_per_member_year.label: Governance time, whole run

hours_network_change_per_post_member_yea.definition: (whole-run reporting and network hours of the arm minus those of control-hierarchy) / post member-years of the arm
hours_network_change_per_post_member_yea.label: Reporting and network time, change vs Hierarchy

hours_network_post_per_member_year.definition: increase of the cumulative reporting and network hours from the branch day on over post member-years
hours_network_post_per_member_year.label: Reporting and network time, from adoption

hours_network_whole_per_member_year.definition: whole-run reporting and network hours over whole-run member-years
hours_network_whole_per_member_year.label: Reporting and network time, whole run

hours_review_change_per_post_member_year.definition: (whole-run review hours of the arm minus those of control-hierarchy) / post member-years of the arm
hours_review_change_per_post_member_year.label: Review time, change vs Hierarchy

hours_review_post_per_member_year.definition: increase of the cumulative review hours from the branch day on over post member-years
hours_review_post_per_member_year.label: Review time, from adoption

hours_review_whole_per_member_year.definition: whole-run review hours over whole-run member-years
hours_review_whole_per_member_year.label: Review time, whole run

hours_verification_change_per_post_membe.definition: (whole-run org. verification hours of the arm minus those of control-hierarchy) / post member-years of the arm
hours_verification_change_per_post_membe.label: Org. verification time, change vs Hierarchy

hours_verification_whole_per_member_year.definition: whole-run org. verification hours over whole-run member-years
hours_verification_whole_per_member_year.label: Org. verification time, whole run

net_operating_result_post_per_member_yea.definition: (revenue - operating cost) over the days from the branch day on, divided by member-years of the same days (active member calendar days / 365.25); operating cost includes the processing charge
net_operating_result_post_per_member_yea.label: Net operating result

net_operating_result_whole_per_member_ye.definition: (revenue - operating cost) of the whole run over whole-run member-years (r11_outcomes definition)
net_operating_result_whole_per_member_ye.label: Net operating result, whole run

processing_charge_per_member_year_post.definition: summary processing_charge_resource_units over post member-years (the shared history carries no charge: control-hierarchy pays none)
processing_charge_per_member_year_post.label: Processing charge

processing_units_per_member_year_post.definition: (automated + witness verification + coordination processing units) over post member-years (history carries none)
processing_units_per_member_year_post.label: Processing units

review_appeal_governance_hours_per_membe.definition: increase of the cumulative review, appeal and governance hours from the branch day on over post member-years (organisational verification hours have no cumulative column and are not included)
review_appeal_governance_hours_per_membe.label: Review, appeal and governance time

review_backlog_at_end_per_member.definition: review_backlog_records / active_members on the last day
review_backlog_at_end_per_member.label: End backlog

unfunded_operating_per_member_year_post.definition: increase of operating_unfunded_resource_units_cumulative from the branch day on over post member-years
unfunded_operating_per_member_year_post.label: Unfunded operating cost

scope.complete_means: all 7 pre-specified arms have a verified day-2191 checkpoint (four-year analysis; not the planned five-year run)
scope.note: started minus complete minus stopped = 0; a non-zero value means worlds that are neither stopped nor complete
scope.worlds_started_source: --started (prespecification, fifth note: ten planned, seven started)
